title: Locked out of my computer after password change
description: I changed my password yesterday and now Windows says my account is locked. I have a month-end report due at noon.

title: Forgot password, can't log in
description: Back from vacation and I can't remember my password. Can you reset it?

title: New hire starting Monday needs an account
description: Jordan Patel joins Sales on Monday as an Account Executive. Needs a login, email, Sales shared drive and the CRM group.

title: Employee leaving Friday, remove access
description: Chris Wong (Finance) last day is Friday 5pm. Please disable access and forward email to his manager.

title: Can't see the Finance shared drive
description: The F: drive disappeared from This PC this morning. Everyone else on my team still has it.

title: Printer on 3rd floor not printing
description: Jobs go to the queue and sit there. The printer shows Ready. About 10 people use this printer.

title: Outlook keeps asking for my password
description: Outlook pops up a password prompt every few minutes even though I type the right password.

title: Laptop is very slow
description: Takes 10 minutes to start and apps freeze. It's been getting worse for a couple of weeks.

title: No internet on my desk computer
description: Wi-Fi works on my phone but my desktop says No Internet. The cable is plugged in.

title: Whole Sales team can't reach the CRM
description: Nobody on Sales can open the CRM site since about 9:15. Other websites work. We have client calls all morning.

title: Disk full warning
description: Windows says C: is almost full and I can't save files.

title: Windows updates keep failing
description: Every night it tries to install updates and rolls back. Error 0x80070002.

title: Need Adobe Acrobat installed
description: I need to edit PDF contracts. Can you install Acrobat on my laptop?

title: Suspicious email asking me to verify my account
description: Got an email from 'Micros0ft Support' saying my mailbox will be deleted unless I log in. I clicked the link but didn't type anything. Was that bad?

title: Lost my phone with the authenticator app
description: My phone was stolen and I can't approve MFA prompts to log in.

title: Monitor flickering
description: The second monitor flickers and goes black every few minutes.

title: Can't connect to VPN from home
description: VPN client says 'connection timed out'. It worked last week.

title: Teams audio not working in meetings
description: People can't hear me in Teams calls but my headset works in other apps.

title: Desktop shows a temporary profile
description: After logging in, my desktop is empty and Windows says I'm signed in with a temporary profile.

title: New laptop setup for transfer from Sales to Marketing
description: Marcus Lee moves from Sales to Marketing on the 1st. Update his groups, drives and department.

title: Shared mailbox needed for support@
description: We need a shared mailbox support@ that 4 people on Operations can read and send from.

title: BitLocker recovery key screen
description: My laptop asks for a BitLocker recovery key after a BIOS update and I can't get past it.

title: Can't print to PDF or any printer
description: Every print job, even Microsoft Print to PDF, does nothing. The print queue window won't open.

title: Website blocked by firewall
description: I need a design site for a campaign but it says blocked by policy.

title: Request: second monitor for new desk
description: Could I get a second monitor and a docking station for my desk?
